question: Which permit authorization and document instance supplies the operative Part I–IV effluent limitations, monitoring requirements, and other conditions incorporated by 'hereof' on the cover page—farmington/final_permit.pdf alone, or also conditions from the related draft fact sheets and statements of basis for farmington (NM0020583), aztec, and gcc?

semantic_arguments.text: in accordance with this cover page
the effluent limitations, monitoring requirements, and other conditions set forth in Part I, Part II, Part III, and Part IV hereof
farmington/statement_of_basis.pdf (DRAFT, NPDES PERMIT NO. NM0020583), aztec/statement_of_basis.pdf (DRAFT), gcc/fact_sheet.pdf (DRAFT)

notes: The target span deictically binds compliance to Parts I–IV of the document containing the cover page, but PASSAGE.md also associates draft documents for three distinct locators. Resolving whether those related documents are separate authorizations or part of the same incorporated condition set changes which enforceable limits and monitoring requirements govern each facility for Federal FY2025.
